notes.title: Update notes for March 21
notes.content:
Hello everyone, as you may have noticed, there is a problem with the game due to a bug. I just updated the build and it should now be gone.

Btw. the latest update makes the game 100% Steam Deck compatible. I'm currently waiting for Valve's review to receive the official "SteamDeck Verified" badge.

Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for purchasing the game!

notes.title: Wallpapers DLC, New Game
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680210/PumPum_2__Wallpapers_DLC/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100089/23be523c6542054d19f911d1f2b2636fd76cacc0.jpg[/img][/url]

Hi! How are you?! If you wanted a cool sexy wallpaper for your PC/Mac (or any other device) with a girl from the game, you would definitely want this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680210/PumPum_2__Wallpapers_DLC][u][b]DLC[/b][/u][/url]. It features all the girls from the game in ultra-clear 8K resolution, as well as close-up versions of the wallpapers. It took me a while to convert and save these wallpapers, but better late than never!

[h3]New game in development[/h3]
If you're wondering who the girl in the picture is, I have great news for all of you because I'm working on a new game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587890/Poon_Puzzle][u][b]Poon Puzzle[/b][/u][/url] . Don't ask me why all my games start with the letter "P"! For some reason, many slang words begin with the letter P, such as Punani, Poozle or PumPum and, of course, Poontang!

The game is in a very early stage of development, I already have a playable version of the game and I am currently working on the animations and trailer as well as improving all other aspects of the game.

Please don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587890/Poon_Puzzle][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100089/7fd499406482c92ae5cab44acaa370773435da64.png[/img][/url] 

Cheers!

notes.title: The game is out!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everybody, the game is finally released!

There was some issues and bugs at the start but now most of them are fixed. Please ensure you have the latest update.

For those who are waiting for Trading cards and Steam Point Shop items: As you know, it takes at least 1-2 weeks before the Steam team activates the cards and items, after which they will review them and may ask for changes.

Thank you all for playing![/h3]
